팔리 사이클(Parlee Cycles)은 2000년 미국 매사추세츠 비벌: Parlee Cycles is a carbon fiber bicycle brand founded in 2000 by Bob Parlee in Beverly, Massachusetts. After more than twenty years working with composites as a boat builder, he started Parlee with a single goal: to build the best bicycle in the world. Every Parlee is built one at a time by the hands of skilled craftspeople, guided by Bob Parlee's design philosophy.
팔리는 퍼포먼스를 '에너지 관리'라는 관점에서 바라봅니다. 라이딩이 40: Parlee sees performance through the lens of 'energy management'. Whether a ride lasts 40 minutes, 4 hours or 4 days, the less energy you lose to road vibration and fatigue, the more power you have left. Sophisticated carbon layups, fit components tailored to the rider's body, and geometry that fits more riders all grow from this philosophy.
25년 이상의 카본 파이버 전문성: More than 25 years of carbon fiber expertise
소량 생산, 한 대씩 완성: Small-batch production, finished one at a time
Feel better, ride faster.<br/>몸이 편해야 더 빨:
Feel better, ride faster.
When your body is at ease, you go faster.
자전거는 라이더 몸의 연장처럼 느껴져야 합니다. 팔리는 진보적인 설계와: A bike should feel like an extension of the rider's body. Parlee pursues that goal through progressive design, complex carbon layups and a fit-first approach applied to both production and custom models. It is a brand for riders who expect excellence and want to be inspired in the saddle.
팔리는 피로를 줄이고 퍼포먼스를 끌어올리기 위해 라이더를 더 편하게 만드: Parlee focuses on making riders more comfortable, to reduce fatigue and raise performance. Above all, Parlee's builders genuinely care about the person who will ride the bike they build.
편안함은 퍼포먼스의 반대말이 아닙니다. 편안함이야말로 퍼포먼스를 만들어내: Comfort is not the opposite of performance. Comfort is the very source of performance.
팔리의 자전거에는 그것을 만든 빌더의 손길과, 끝없이 이어지는 엔지니어링: Every Parlee carries the touch of the builder who made it, along with an endless pursuit of better engineering.
정직과 진정성, 자신이 만든 제품에 끝까지 책임지는 태도. 팔리는 라이더: Honesty, authenticity, and standing behind what we make to the very end. Parlee is a brand that values its riders and partners.
더 적게 만들기 때문에 한 대 한 대가 특별해질 수 있습니다. 팔리는 언: Because we make fewer, each one can be special. Parlee always builds by hand.
“We founded Parlee in 2000 with one simple but ambitious goal: to build the best bicycle in the world.”
보트 제작 분야에서 20년 넘게 일하며 저는 복합소재가 가진 가능성을 잘: After more than twenty years in boat building, I knew what composites were capable of. Carbon fiber was clearly the material that could take performance bicycles to the next level, but at the time its potential was far from fully realized. Carbon lets you optimize the size and shape of each tube and finely tune weight, strength, durability and compliance. The more you refine layup schedules and molding techniques, the lighter, faster and more comfortable the bike becomes.
오늘날 카본 파이버는 거의 모든 퍼포먼스 자전거의 소재가 되었고, 그만큼: Today carbon fiber is the material of nearly every performance bicycle, and with that, carbon can turn designers into stylists. But style must never be mistaken for performance. Unnecessary shapes only add weight and degrade the ride. It is like putting fins on a car: it may look great, but it will not make the car any faster.
우리의 원칙은 효율입니다. 로드 레이싱, 매일의 트레이닝, 시클로크로스,: Our principle is efficiency. From road racing and daily training to cyclocross and all-day gravel adventures, we use carbon strategically to deliver exactly the performance each purpose demands. Performance tuned to the goal and fit tuned to the body: that is what defines a Parlee.
밥 팔리 (Bob Parlee), 팔리 사이클 창립자: Bob Parlee, founder of Parlee Cycles
Different roads, one principle. The ride always comes first.
빨라야 할 곳에서는 빠르고, 부드러워야 할 곳에서는 부드럽게. 현실의 도: Fast where it needs to be fast, smooth where it needs to be smooth. An all-road bike for real-world roads.
포장도로가 끝나는 곳에서 비로소 살아나는 그래블 바이크. 빠르고, 유능하: A gravel bike that truly comes alive where the pavement ends. Fast, capable and composed on any surface.
25년 카본 노하우로 완성한, 라이더 한 사람을 위해 맞춤 제작하는 퍼포: A performance road bike built to measure for a single rider, refined by 25 years of carbon know-how.
팔리 유레이(Ouray)는 매일 마주하는 현실의 도로를 위해 설계된 올로: The Parlee Ouray is an all-road bike designed for the real roads you ride every day. It lets you dream of longer routes and bigger goals, without the fatigue. Fast where it needs to be fast, smooth where it needs to be smooth, the Ouray gives you the freedom to enjoy the road without giving anything up.
2025년 미국 Bicycling 매거진은 유레이를 올로드 바이크 오브: In 2025, Bicycling magazine in the US named the Ouray its All-Road Bike of the Year.
현실의 도로는 거칩니다. 하지만 라이딩까지 거칠 필요는 없습니다. 유레이: Real roads are rough. Your ride doesn't have to be. The Ouray soaks up road buzz, keeping you focused and fast even when the tarmac looks like a building site.
먼 길로 돌아가는 즐거움: The joy of taking the long way round
모든 거리를 음미하세요. 더 멀리, 더 빠르게 달리면서도 끝까지 몸이 가: Savor every mile. A bike for riders who want to go further and faster and still feel fresh at the finish.
마감과 피팅, 컴포넌트까지 내가 어떻게, 어디를 달리는지에 맞춰 고릅니다: Finish, fit and components, all chosen around how and where you ride. Modern performance means a bike shaped around you.
모든 표면과 조인트, 윤곽은 좋은 자전거가 어떤 느낌이어야 하는지 아는: Every surface, joint and contour passes through hands that know how a great bike should feel. You can sense 25 years of experience in every kilometer.
“강하게 밟을 때의 반응과 편안함에 크게 감탄했습니다. 레이스 바이크처럼: “I was really impressed by how it responded when I put the power down, and by its comfort. If you want a bike that is as fast as a race bike without having to contort yourself to fit one, the Ouray might be exactly the answer.”

유레이는 팔리가 그리는 현대 로드바이크의 모습입니다. 출발은 더 빠르고,: The Ouray is Parlee's vision of the modern road bike. Quicker off the line, more stable at speed, and designed for real-world road conditions. Where other road platforms emphasize either comfort or speed, the Ouray strikes a balance between the two, creating a bike that is fast, confident and eager to go any distance.
가벼운 구조와 세련된 핸들링 덕분에 긴 솔로 라이딩, 구간 기록 경쟁,: Its light construction and refined handling make it feel natural on long solo rides, segment hunts and weekend adventures alike. A bike that lets you hold race-bike speed all day long: that is the Ouray.
Lightweight,
but more than just a lightweight.
Z5와 알텀(Altum)이 쌓아온 유산 위에서, 유레이는 팔리 로드바이크: Building on the legacy of the Z5 and the Altum, the Ouray opens a new era for Parlee road bikes. A sloping top tube and dropped stays tune compliance for all-day comfort, while improved lateral and torsional stiffness carries speed without effort. A stable wheelbase keeps the bike planted on the road, and the monocoque carbon frame filters out road buzz without dulling the feedback from the surface.
공기역학적으로 깔끔한 라인과 목적에 맞춘 형상은 저항을 줄여, 바람에 노: Aerodynamically clean lines and purpose-driven shapes cut drag, preserving momentum on long, exposed climbs and descents. The result is clear: a road bike that is decisively faster, lighter and more capable than the generation before it.
유레이가 진정으로 빛나는 순간은 바로 그 침착함입니다. 코너에 들어서면: Where the Ouray truly shines is its composure. Into a corner, it grips the asphalt with a planted confidence that keeps you calm and fast. Broken pavement, endless roadworks and neglected country lanes pass beneath it without hesitation.
최대 40mm 타이어 클리어런스로 편안함과 그립, 겨울철 노면을 위해 더: With clearance for tires up to 40mm, you can run wider rubber for comfort, grip or winter roads without losing speed. Enjoy race-bike speed without the aches, and without white-knuckling the bars.
In the Nude, 숨길 것이 없는 카본: In the Nude: carbon with nothing to hide
팔리의 엔지니어링 팀이 설계하고 포르투갈의 장인들이 손으로 완성하는 유레: Designed by Parlee's engineering team and finished by hand by craftspeople in Portugal, the Ouray frame is built with a precise carbon layup that leaves no excess weight. Because every ply sits exactly where it should, no filler, cosmetic layers or adhesives are needed. So there is nothing to hide.
최고 수준의 카본 기술이 필요해 다른 제조사들이 거의 시도하지 않는 이: This method demands the highest level of carbon expertise, which is why few other manufacturers attempt it. Thanks to it, each frame emerges from the mold with a flawless surface. That is why Parlee offers the Ouray in raw carbon with a subtle wax coating.
모든 프레임은 소량으로 한 대씩 만들어지고, 미국 본사에서 주문에 맞춰: Every frame is made in small batches, one at a time, and individually assembled to order at Parlee's headquarters in the US. Once you choose a frame size, fit components are selected to match your body measurements, so the bike suits both your size and your riding style.
With Parlee Paint Lab, the customization possibilities are (nearly) endless. Thanks to size-specific geometry and personalized component choices, the Ouray fits more riders well, right from the start.

The End of Compromise.

그래블이 점점 더 세분화된 장르로 나뉘는 지금, 팔리 타오스(Taos)는: As gravel splinters into ever more specialized niches, the Parlee Taos brings them all together. Why compromise when you can have it all?
The Taos was built for the future of gravel, and it looks the part. It is a modern gravel bike that truly comes alive where the pavement ends. In 2025, BikeRadar and CyclingPlus named the Taos their Gravel Bike of the Year.
그래블 바이크로 위장한 로드바이크가 아닙니다. 탁월한 핸들링과 미래지향적: This is not a road bike disguised as a gravel bike. With exceptional handling and forward-thinking engineering, it turns every ride into an epic adventure.
즉각적인 가속과 하루 종일 이어지는 퍼포먼스를 위해 설계했습니다. 빠름은: Designed for instant acceleration and all-day performance. Speed is in the Taos DNA.
피팅과 스타일, 마감까지. 모든 팔리 자전거는 그것을 타는 라이더를 닮도: Fit, style and finish. Every Parlee is personalized to reflect the rider who rides it.
세밀한 부분까지 손으로 완성한 팔리는 다른 어떤 자전거와도 다른 라이딩을: Finished by hand down to the smallest detail, a Parlee rides unlike any other bike. You can feel 25 years of experience on every ride.
뼈를 울리는 레이싱 바이크의 딱딱함과, 무겁고 둔한 어드벤처 빌드 사이에: No more choosing between the bone-rattling stiffness of a race bike and the heavy, sluggish feel of an adventure build. One bike that unites high-speed efficiency with composure on rough terrain. This is the future of gravel.
타오스는 더 길고 슬랙한 지오메트리로 기존 그래블 바이크와 과감히 결별합: With longer, slacker geometry, the Taos makes a bold break from conventional gravel bikes. But every choice has a reason. One look tells you this is no road bike with wide tires squeezed in. The Taos is a concept designed from the ground up to inspire almost addictive confidence.
모노코크 프레임 구조는 매우 가벼울 뿐 아니라 더 나은 동력 전달을 만들: The monocoque frame construction is not only extremely light but also delivers better power transfer. A torsionally stiff lower section and a compact, sloping front triangle smooth out the ride and make the rider faster.
진보적인 설계와 정교하게 완성된 카본 레이업은 완전히 새로운 그래블 경험: Progressive design and a meticulously refined carbon layup deliver an entirely new gravel experience. A long reach and slack head angle provide confident, stable handling at speed, while a low BB and short chainstays smooth out rough surfaces and keep the bike planted through corners and descents.
고속 안정성과 최대의 동력 전달로 험로를 넘고, 평지를 삼키고, 오르막을: With high-speed stability and maximum power transfer, it conquers rough terrain, devours the flats and flies up the climbs. Each of the six frame sizes has its own dedicated layup and geometry, delivering the same ride from the smallest size to the largest.
넉넉한 50mm 타이어 클리어런스와 서스펜션 보정 지오메트리로 오프로드의: With generous 50mm tire clearance and suspension-corrected geometry, the off-road options are endless. A removable front derailleur mount supports both 1x and 2x setups, and you can add a suspension fork or even choose mountain bike tires without compromising the ride.
타이어만 바꿔도 전혀 다른 노면에서 탁월한 승차감을 냅니다. 매끈한 저트: Simply swapping tires delivers an outstanding ride on completely different surfaces. Smooth, low-tread tires suit the pavement, while wide knobby tires take on rougher terrain. Generous internal down tube storage, fender mounts, top tube bag mounts and stealth dropper post routing. Whether you are racing the clock or chasing the sun, it is ready for any adventure.
The precision layup, made by hand by craftspeople in Portugal, carries no dead weight. Every carbon ply is placed exactly where intended, creating a frame that needs no cosmetic layers, filler or adhesives. Unlike mass-produced carbon frames, there is nothing to cover up.
이렇게 공들인 제작 방식은 몰드에서 꺼낸 그대로 완벽한 표면을 만들어냅니: This painstaking construction produces a perfect surface straight from the mold. That is why the Taos is offered in fully nude carbon with a wax finish. No need to worry about cosmetic damage like paint chips or scratches.
모든 프레임은 소량으로 한 대씩 만들어지고, 미국 본사에서 주문에 맞춰: Every frame is made in small batches, one at a time, and individually assembled to order at Parlee's headquarters in the US. Once you choose a frame size, fit components are selected to match your body measurements. Choose a standard build and paint, or pick every detail yourself. After all, it is your bike.
로고 컬러 옵션, 스탠다드 페인트 스킴, 완전한 커스텀 페인트까지. 커스: Logo color options, standard paint schemes, all the way to fully custom paint. The customization possibilities are (nearly) endless.

the Taos keeps going.
칠레 푸에르토몬트에서 출발해 세상의 끝, 아르헨티나 우수아이아에서 끝나는: Final Frontier Patagonia is an ultra challenge that starts in Puerto Montt, Chile, and finishes at the end of the world in Ushuaia, Argentina. 라이더 데이브 아서(Dave Arthur)가 이 도전을 감당할 자전거를: When rider Dave Arthur asked which bike could take on the challenge, Parlee's answer was the Taos. Opening the door to bigger rides, wilder places and stories worth telling: that is what Parlee believes a good bike should do.

팔리의 Z 시리즈는 25년 넘게 장인정신과 품질, 반복을 거듭한 설계의: For more than 25 years, Parlee's Z Series has set the standard for craftsmanship, quality and iteratively refined design. Parlee's multi-award-winning flagship road platform is built by hand by craftspeople in a small workshop 45 minutes north of Boston.
2025년 완전히 새로워진 Z-Zero GT는 도로에 보내는 연서이자,: Completely reimagined for 2025, the Z-Zero GT is a love letter to the road and a reaffirmation of the value of building a bike for one rider rather than for everyone. It is designed to cover long distances over countless mountains with speed and luxurious comfort. Wherever it goes, it is a modern classic that will turn heads for generations.
팔리의 자전거는 엔지니어링의 완성입니다. 획일적인 디자인과 익명의 대량생: A Parlee is the culmination of engineering. It is a reaction against uniform design and anonymous mass production, and a testament to the value of bespoke craftsmanship. From the visible surfaces to the places no one sees, it pursues perfection to the extreme.
모든 커스텀 Z 시리즈는 라이더 고유의 스타일을 반영하며 한계를 넓히고: Every custom Z Series reflects the rider's own style, pushing limits and outpacing the competition. The GT embodies the future of road cycling and an endless desire to explore.
Z 시리즈는 언제나 최고 수준의 제작 품질을 대표해 왔습니다. GT는 편: The Z Series has always represented the highest standard of build quality. With the GT, the carbon layup has been optimized once again for comfort, responsiveness and astonishing speed. It is the fastest Z Series ever and the lightest bike in its family.
25년간 다듬어온 정교한 카본 레이업은 진동을 흡수해, 섬세한 감각과 도: A precise carbon layup refined over 25 years absorbs vibration, leaving only fine sensation and a pure connection to the road.
GT의 핸드메이드 프레임은 카본 파이버 기술의 정수를 보여주며, 세상에서: The GT's handmade frame showcases the pinnacle of carbon fiber technology and delivers the smoothest ride in the world. Using Parlee's own methods, the carbon layup has been optimized even further, elevating comfort, responsiveness and astonishing speed together.
An all-new layup and design shave a remarkable 187g off the previous model. A stronger, lighter full-carbon UDH chainstay module opens up compatibility with current and future drivetrains. The fully integrated fork, designed and built in-house by Parlee, offers a clean look with no exposed cables, one-piece bar and stem compatibility, and clearance for tires up to 40mm. Working in harmony, the frame and fork improve ride quality, aerodynamics and perceived speed alike.
GT는 핸들링을 극대화하고 라이더의 편안함과 효율을 높이도록 처음부터 다: The GT was redesigned from the ground up to maximize handling and boost rider comfort and efficiency. The BB sits 10mm lower than on a typical road bike, lowering the center of gravity, and this small, subtle change noticeably increases stability. The new, stiffer chainstay module transfers pedaling torque to the road without loss.
아스팔트에서 농로, 가끔의 그래블까지. GT는 어떤 노면이든 특유의 자신: From asphalt to farm roads and the occasional gravel, the GT meets any surface with its signature confidence.
GT의 12가지 스탠다드 사이즈(레이스 또는 스포츠 지오메트리)는 각각: Each of the GT's 12 standard sizes (Race or Sport geometry) has its own reference geometry and ships with a combination of crank length, stem length, handlebar width, seatpost setback and saddle width tailored to the individual rider.
레퍼런스 사이즈는 시작일 뿐입니다. 풀 비스포크 Z-Zero GT를 선택: Reference sizes are only the beginning. Choose a fully bespoke Z-Zero GT and you get geometry and a frame configuration tailored to your profile. It is an ultra-precise process that makes the GT feel like part of your body. And Parlee Paint Lab turns any color and design you can imagine into reality.
스탠다드 GT 페인트 20컬러 또는 누드 카본 (커스텀 가능): 20 standard GT paint colors or Nude Carbon (custom available)
세라믹스피드 헤드셋, GT 스페이서·헤드셋 캡: CeramicSpeed headset, GT spacers and headset cap
Black Inc HB01 콕핏, 팔리 카본 싯포스트: Black Inc HB01 cockpit, Parlee carbon seatpost
셀레 이탈리아 SLR 카본 안장, 티타늄 패스너 키트: Selle Italia SLR carbon saddle, titanium fastener kit
피렐리 P-Zero TLR 레이스 35mm, 투볼리토 TPU 튜브: Pirelli P-Zero TLR Race 35mm, Tubolito TPU tubes
12개의 레퍼런스 지오메트리를 넘어, 라이더의 피팅 데이터에 맞춘 완전한: Beyond the 12 reference geometries, we build with fully custom geometry and a frame configuration matched to the rider's fit data.
콕핏과 헤드셋, 물통 케이지, 싯포스트까지 프레임과 같은 컬러로 맞춰 도: An extended paint option that finishes the cockpit, headset, bottle cages and seatpost in the same color as the frame.
모던 퍼포먼스 로드 지오메트리, 튜브 투 튜브 핸드메이드 구조, 미국 제: Modern performance road geometry, handmade tube-to-tube construction, made in the USA
12개 사이즈(레이스 · 스포츠), 커스텀 지오메트리 가능, 7~10°: 12 sizes (Race · Sport), custom geometry available, 7–10° sloping top tube
미국산 Z-Zero 전용 튜브, 라이더·사이즈별 강성 옵션: US-made tubes dedicated to the Z-Zero, stiffness options by rider and size
GT 전용 핸드 레이업 체인·싯스테이, 사이즈별 라이더 최적화 레이업: GT-specific hand-laid chainstays and seatstays, rider-optimized layup for each size
풀 인테그레이티드 내장 라우팅, 캄파놀로·스램·시마노 호환: Fully integrated internal routing, compatible with Campagnolo, SRAM and Shimano
플랫마운트 디스크, 내장 라우팅, 리어 140/160mm · 프론트 16: Flat-mount disc, internal routing, rear 140/160mm · front 160/180mm
팔리 GT 카본, 테이퍼드 D형 스티어러, 일체형 크라운 레이스, 12m: Parlee GT carbon, tapered D-shaped steerer, integrated crown race, 12mm thru-axle
세라믹스피드 SLT 세라믹 베어링, 상단 IS41 · 하단 IS47: CeramicSpeed SLT ceramic bearings, upper IS41 · lower IS47
GT 커스텀 스킴 20컬러 또는 누드 왁스 마감, 팔리 페인트 랩 커스텀: GT custom scheme in 20 colors or nude wax finish, custom available through Parlee Paint Lab
레이스 지오메트리는 낮고 긴 포지션을, 스포츠 지오메트리는 더 높은 스택: Race geometry offers a low, long position, while Sport geometry provides a more relaxed position with higher stack and shorter reach. Custom geometry is designed separately based on your fit data.
25년의 유산을 기리며, 창립자 밥 팔리와 그가 사이클링 산업, 그리고: Honoring 25 years of heritage, this limited-edition Z-Zero GT celebrates founder Bob Parlee and his contributions to the cycling industry and to carbon fiber engineering. Parlee's vision of 'the best bicycle in the world' is completed with limited-edition components from engineering leaders around the globe. Only 25 will be made, and never again.
최고를 만든다는 것은 무엇을 의미할까요. 1999년, 밥 팔리는 그 질문: What does it mean to build the best? In 1999, Bob Parlee set aside his career as a boat builder to answer that question. From day one, his goal was the best bicycle in the world, and every morning he woke up thinking about what the best could be.
최고를 만드는 일은 정말 어렵습니다. 밥은 일이 어려워져도 결코 멈추지: Building the best is genuinely hard. Bob never stopped, even when the work got difficult. The team that worked alongside him every day until his passing in late 2024 decided to carry his vision forward and build a bike in his honor.
공식은 늘 단순했습니다. 최고의 소재를 구하고, 가장 숙련된 사람들에게: The formula was always simple. Source the finest materials, entrust them to the most skilled people, and give them the time and space to make something beautiful. Add the best components available, and you have the best bike money can buy.
밥 곁에는 늘 종이와 연필이 있었고, 그의 스케치에는 명암을 표현하는 우: Bob always had paper and pencil at hand, and his sketches were filled with elegant hatching to render light and shadow. Those lines, the motif behind the Parlee head badge, now appear in deep candy blue on the top tube and the bar and stem. Hand-applied 24K gold leaf recalls the gilded signs of the old sailing ships Bob worked on in his youth.
Bob was a quiet man who preferred the workbench to the telephone. Ask him to describe how a bike rode and he would simply answer, "Ride it." Before long, the team had come to call that answer 'Ride The F***ing Bike'. On hard days, or when your head is full, the answer may just be to get on the bike and keep pedaling.
2006년 설립된 팔리 페인트 랩은 본사 1층에 자리한, 북미 최고 수준: Founded in 2006 and located on the ground floor of the headquarters, Parlee Paint Lab is regarded as one of the finest bicycle painting teams in North America. Their craft, which has pioneered new finishes on carbon fiber, shines in every detail of the 25th Anniversary Edition.
커스텀은 복잡하지 않습니다.<br/>12개의 레퍼런스 지오메트리,<br/:
Custom doesn't have to be complicated.
12 reference geometries,
endless fit possibilities.
25년이 넘는 시간 동안 팔리의 사명은 변하지 않았습니다. 세상에서 가장: For more than 25 years, Parlee's mission has never changed: to build the best bicycle in the world. Every Parlee Z Series has always been made 100% by hand in Beverly, Massachusetts, for the one person who will ride it.
팔리의 독보적인 커스터마이징 능력은 단순한 원칙 하나에서 시작되는 다층적: Parlee's unmatched customization capability is the result of a multilayered process that begins with one simple principle: listening. Parlee knows that the most important part of building a custom bike is communication between the rider, the fitter and the builder.
25년 넘게 축적한 커스텀 피팅 데이터를 분석해 12개의 레퍼런스 지오메: By analyzing custom fit data gathered over more than 25 years, Parlee created 12 reference geometries. Each can be adjusted as far as the rider's body measurements and riding style require, resulting in the widest range of geometry available in custom carbon fiber.
모든 커스텀 설계는 팔리 독자의 CAD 시스템으로 라이더의 접점을 모델링: Every custom design is developed with Parlee's proprietary CAD system, which models the rider's contact points and aligns them with the actual frame geometry. Once the rider approves, the production team determines the exact dimensions and carbon layup schedule for a perfect fit and a better ride.
모든 팔리는 라이더의 치수에 맞춘 부품과 함께 출고됩니다. 크랭크 길이,: Every Parlee ships with components matched to the rider's measurements. Crank length, cockpit dimensions, saddle width and seatpost offset are chosen for each individual. Shimano, Campagnolo or SRAM groupsets, along with ZIPP, HED, ENVE or whatever else you want, can all be specified.
커스텀 업계에서 가장 빠른 수준의 리드타임을 목표로 합니다. 일정을 예측: We aim for some of the fastest lead times in the custom industry. Schedules stay predictable, and riders can follow along as their bike is built. (Based on shipping from the US workshop.)
설계부터 마감까지, 여섯 단계: From design to finish, in six steps
모든 것은 라이더의 피팅 데이터에서 시작합니다. 커스텀 CAD 소프트웨어: Everything begins with the rider's fit data. Using custom CAD software, we draw the blueprint of the perfect bike, then send every detail as a document for review before a single tube is made.
We start with premium UD prepreg carbon, the benchmark for high-performance composites. Every tube and subassembly is made by hand for the individual rider, and nothing is made in advance.
라이더가 원하는 승차감에 맞춰 튜브를 고르고 조립합니다. 마이터 가공한: Tubes are selected and assembled to deliver the ride the rider wants. Mitered tubes are joined to lugs by hand to tune stiffness, and correct fiber orientation is the key to frame strength and ride quality.
팔리 독자의 가열·가압 공정을 거쳐 깨지지 않는 결합을 만들어냅니다. 이: Parlee's proprietary heat and pressure process creates an unbreakable bond. This molding process ensures a consistent surface finish.
페인트나 왁스 마감 전에 프레임을 손으로 샌딩하고 세척합니다. 케이블 스: Before paint or wax, each frame is hand-sanded and cleaned. Carbon fittings such as cable stops and front derailleur mounts are all made in-house, creating the lightest and strongest connection between frame and components.
점점 더 고운 사포로 이어지는 철저한 습식 샌딩으로 거울 같은 광택을 만: Meticulous wet sanding through progressively finer grits produces a mirror-like gloss. Painted or left nude, the Z-Zero GT is made to stand out anywhere.
모든 팔리 Z-Zero는 매사추세츠 비벌리의 최신 설비를 갖춘 팔리 공방: Every Parlee Z-Zero is built in Parlee's state-of-the-art workshop in Beverly, Massachusetts. The Z-Zero GT pictured is finished with a gloss clear coat over carbon and Rolling Thunder logos.
루비워크샵에서는 피팅 데이터 측정부터 지오메트리 확인, 페인트 디자인,: At Rubi Workshop in Seoul, we guide you through every step of a Parlee bespoke build, from measuring your fit data and confirming geometry to paint design and aftercare once your bike is delivered.
팔리 페인트 랩(Parlee Paint Lab)은 세계 최고 수준의 페인: Parlee Paint Lab is recognized as one of the finest paint programs in the world. From predesigned schemes that make the decision easy to full custom work that brings your dream design to life, understated or bold, Parlee Paint Lab does it all.
2006년 설립되어 본사 1층에 자리한 페인트 랩은 카본 파이버 위의 새: Founded in 2006 and located on the ground floor of the headquarters, Paint Lab is a team that has pioneered new finishes on carbon fiber.
모든 컬러 무광 · 유광 선택 가능: Every color available in matte or gloss
팔리 페인트 랩은 20가지 컬러 팔레트를 제공합니다. 시선을 사로잡는 대: Parlee Paint Lab offers a palette of 20 colors. Whether you want a bold, head-turning hue or understated sophistication, you can fully express your personality and style.
칠한 것이 아니라 부어낸 듯 깊고 풍부한 솔리드 화이트. 로고나 포인트: A deep, rich solid white that looks poured rather than painted. Best suited to logos or accent colors.
메탈릭 효과의 다크 그레이. 그레이 핀스트라이프 수트처럼 시대를 타지 않: A dark gray with a metallic effect. Timeless class, like a gray pinstripe suit.
프로방스의 라벤더 밭에서 영감을 받았습니다. 여권 없이 떠나는 남프랑스: Inspired by the lavender fields of Provence. A trip to the south of France, no passport required.
A dazzling blue, like the perfect Italian holiday bottled and turned into paint.
80년대 후반 어느 이탈리아 림브레이크 캘리퍼를 떠올리게 하는 깊은 블루: A deep blue reminiscent of a certain late-80s Italian rim brake caliper.
라임 그린과 네온 옐로 사이의 밝은 메탈릭. 대담한 라이더를 위한 선택입: A bright metallic between lime green and neon yellow. A choice for bold riders.
Neither green nor gold, but somewhere in between. Its metallic effect comes alive in sunlight.
Parlee's take on the beloved classic British Racing Green.
이름처럼 두 얼굴. 각도와 빛에 따라 그린으로, 퍼플로, 때로는 둘 다로: Two faces, just like the name. Depending on angle and light, it reads green, purple, or sometimes both.
A refined purple with a dazzling metallic finish.
A punchy orange for riders who want to be noticed.
Where passion meets speed. A classic red with metallic flake.
An elegant, deep red, like a well-aged wine.
위스키가 태어나는 스코틀랜드 언덕에서 영감을 받아, 각도에 따라 골드와: Inspired by the Scottish hills where whisky is born, shifting between gold and red with the angle.
A purple as soft as velvet. Best chosen with Prince playing.
페인트와 클리어코트 사이. 그늘에서는 어둡고, 햇빛 아래에서는 색이 폭발: Somewhere between paint and clear coat. Dark in the shade, its color bursts to life in sunlight.
보름달 뜬 밤하늘처럼, 그늘에서는 은은한 다크 블루가 햇빛 아래에서 생동: Like a night sky under a full moon, a subtle dark blue in the shade turns vivid in sunlight.
Dark in the shade, but a red that burns hot when it catches the light.
A clear finish that reveals the carbon craftsmanship that makes the bike special.
A dark color with a metallic sheen, like Iceland's black sand beaches.
모니터 환경에 따라 실제 컬러와 다르게 보일 수 있습니다. 루비워크샵에서: Colors may look different from the actual paint depending on your display. You can confirm your final choice with color samples at Rubi Workshop in Seoul.
팔리 시그니처 누드 카본 마감에 원하는 데칼 컬러를 더합니다. 4가지 로: Add the decal color of your choice to Parlee's signature Nude Carbon finish. Choose from four logo packs to easily make your Ouray or Taos your own.
커스텀 페인트의 세계로 들어서는 첫걸음. 20가지 페인트 갤러리에서 프레: Your first step into the world of custom paint. Choose a frame color and a logo color separately from the 20-color paint gallery.
팔레트 외 컬러는 별도 견적: Colors outside the palette quoted separately
한계가 없습니다. 팔리 사내 디자인팀과 함께 풀 커스텀으로 상상한 디자인: No limits. Work with Parlee's in-house design team to bring the design you imagine to life in full custom. Pick from the lineup's colors, or go completely off the menu.
팔리 디자이너와 1:1 상담 (45분): One-on-one consultation with a Parlee designer (45 minutes)
For more than 25 years,
bikes you don't just ride,
but experience.
팔리는 커스텀 지오메트리로 잘 알려져 있지만, 900g 이하 카본 로드: Parlee is best known for custom geometry, but it was also the first brand to build a carbon road frame under 900g. A few years later, it broke the 800g barrier as well. Along the way, Parlee designs have earned major honors including Bicycling magazine's Editors' Choice, Cycling Weekly Race Bike of the Year, the Eurobike Design Award, Bicycling All-Road Bike of the Year and BikeRadar Gravel Bike of the Year.
Bob Parlee founds Parlee Cycles and builds the first prototype.
The first Z1 frame is unveiled to the public.
The first Z2 and Z3 prototypes are built.
The first custom sloping-geometry Z3 is introduced.
Cycling Weekly가 Z3를 레이스 바이크 오브 더 이어로 선정합: Cycling Weekly names the Z3 its Race Bike of the Year.
Bicycling 매거진이 Z1을 에디터스 초이스로 선정하고, 팔리는 Z: Bicycling magazine names the Z1 an Editors' Choice, and Parlee introduces the Z4.
업계 최초의 플렉스 핏 지오메트리로 스톡 프레임이 더 많은 라이더에게 맞: The industry's first Flex Fit geometry helps stock frames fit more riders.
Parlee x Prius 프로젝트로 '뉴럴 시프팅'이라는 미래의 단면을: The Parlee x Prius project offers a glimpse of the future called 'neural shifting'.
The Z-Zero is introduced, a new benchmark for custom carbon frames.
The new Z5i and TTi models are introduced.
Parlee's first aero road bike, the ESX, is introduced alongside the TTiR.
모바도와 협업해 카본 파이버 시계를 선보이고, 알텀(Altum) 패밀리를: A carbon fiber watch is launched in collaboration with Movado, and the Altum family is released.
첫 그래블 바이크 체바코(Chebacco)와 Z-Zero XD를 선보입니: The first gravel bike, the Chebacco, is introduced alongside the Z-Zero XD.
디스크 브레이크를 단 첫 트라이애슬론 바이크, 새로운 TTiR을 출시합니: The new TTiR launches, the first triathlon bike with disc brakes.
The RZ7, a next-generation performance aero road bike, is introduced.
원피스 모노코크 프레임의 모던 로드바이크 유레이를 선보입니다. 새 CEO: The Ouray, a modern road bike with a one-piece monocoque frame, is introduced. It is the first model under new CEO and owner John Harrison.
유레이와 같은 모노코크 구조의 미래지향적 그래블 바이크 타오스를 선보입니: The Taos, a forward-looking gravel bike sharing the Ouray's monocoque construction, is introduced.
Bicycling 매거진이 유레이를 올로드 바이크 오브 더 이어로 선정합: Bicycling magazine names the Ouray its All-Road Bike of the Year.
